title: Value Portrait: Assessing Language Models’ Values through Psychometrically and Ecologically Valid Items
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark to evaluate LLMs using Schwartz’s Theory of Basic Values, which includes 'Tradition' (explicitly linked to religious customs and ideas). Furthermore, the study specifically evaluates the models' performance across religious demographic personas (Atheist, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim, Protestant) and categorizes a significant portion of its test items under 'Philosophy and ethics'.
